description: R2-PREP (CTO §A): prove the evidence-pack harness end-to-end on a CONTROLLED, SYNTHETIC external-style repository fixture (NO third-party access, NO private data/secrets). authorization.authorization_source: CTO AUTHORIZATION 'R2-PREP + $10M CHANNEL STRATEGY CONTINUATION' §A (internal controlled/synthetic fixture only; no third-party repo access).

work_item_contract.scope: Internal controlled/synthetic fixture only. NO third-party repository access (BLOCKED_BY_DEPENDENCY until explicit owner consent). NO source change to the evidence engine (test-only). NO network/secrets/private data.
invariants: Fixture is synthetic + public package names only; no private data/secrets; no network.
Result = CONTROLLED_FIXTURE_VERIFIED; explicitly NOT a client validation and NOT R2 completion.
False-success guards tested (tampered attestation ⇒ verify fails; empty lockfile ⇒ honest 0-component; malformed entry skipped).
supply-chain-attest source unchanged (test-only); dual-port parity preserved.
Preserve uncommitted V1/V2/V3 research docs + 5 stashes; do not commit them here.
acceptance_criteria: Harness ALL PASS on the fixture (SBOM/provenance+tamper/reproducibility/parity/licence-risk/debt/empty-negative); existing supply-chain-attest test green; tsc 0; committed within write-set.
stop_conditions: Any step would need third-party repo access, network, secrets, or a source change outside the write-set.
work_item_contract.rollback: git checkout -- ODG_PROJECT_STATE.md; delete src/runtime/r2-evidence-pack-fixture.test.ts + this contract.

done_when: Harness ALL PASS on synthetic external fixture; regression green; tsc 0; committed.

definition_of_done: Evidence-pack harness CONTROLLED_FIXTURE_VERIFIED on a synthetic external fixture; false-success guards proven; committed (no force); R2 real external proof remains BLOCKED_BY_DEPENDENCY.
